contract.agreement: One or two survivors is the reasonable aim for the sub-1000 armies usually tested. The shared audit README also gives 0.1% of combined initial troops as an accuracy aim and investigation diagnostic, not a universal hard failure. contract.raw_provenance: Report images are optional for all existing recorded outcomes. Direct artifact links provide supporting detail; keep images for new captures when available.
